# satisfactory_foundation (Resource)

A foundation (or other passive structural buildable) placed in the world. Every change replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "satisfactory_foundation" "pad" {
  class = "Build_Foundation_8x4_01_C"
  x     = 0
  y     = 0
  z     = 20000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `class` (String) Buildable class name, e.g. Build_Foundation_8x4_01_C.
- `x` (Number) World X in centimetres.
- `y` (Number) World Y in centimetres.
- `z` (Number) World Z in centimetres.

### Optional

- `yaw` (Number) Rotation around the vertical axis in degrees.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform-assigned stable ID, persisted in the save game by the mod.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the resource's tf_id (the UUID the mod persists in the save).
terraform import satisfactory_foundation.pad "0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789"
```
